scope: Official NYC DCP ZAP/land-use source audit for observed-change candidates, 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.

sources.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; cite NYC Department of City Planning and the dataset name.
sources.coverage_years: Queried for official milestone/status dates from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19; dataset includes older and current ZAP project rows.
sources.update_frequency: Catalog metadata describes the dataset as regularly maintained by DCP; verify current metadata before production ingestion.
sources.geographic_scope_and_granularity: NYC land-use project/application rows; geometry requires BBL or project-detail joins.
sources.reliability_assessment: strong for administrative project status, action identifiers, and milestone dates; usable with caveats for project descriptions.
sources.required_caveats: Do not treat approval, adoption, certification, or completion in ZAP as evidence of physical construction, opening, occupancy, or outcomes.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use as the primary cited source for land-use application milestones; store project_id as source_record_id and preserve source_date_field.

sources.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; cite NYC Department of City Planning and the dataset name.
sources.coverage_years: Current project-to-BBL association table queried on 2026-05-19.
sources.update_frequency: Maintained with ZAP data; verify current catalog metadata for production ingestion.
sources.geographic_scope_and_granularity: ZAP project to validated borough/block/lot rows.
sources.reliability_assessment: strong when validated='TRUE'; review manually when BBLs are missing or unvalidated.
sources.required_caveats: Associated BBLs are not the same as official project footprint polygons or built-form boundaries.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use as the official geometry bridge for ZAP rows; retain BBL count and validation metadata.

sources.source_name: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
sources.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; cite NYC Department of City Planning and the dataset name.
sources.update_frequency: DCP publishes PLUTO periodically; verify current catalog metadata before production ingestion.
sources.geographic_scope_and_granularity: NYC tax lot, with BBL, address, and representative latitude/longitude.
sources.reliability_assessment: usable with caveats for representative map points.
sources.required_caveats: PLUTO coordinates are current lot reference points and are not historical footprints or official land-use action polygons.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use for candidate triage map points only when project-specific official geometry is unavailable.
